def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    node_by_id = {node['id']: node for node in nodes}
    # Build children list
    parent_children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        parent = node['parent']
        if parent is not None:
            parent_children.setdefault(parent, []).append(node['id'])
    # Initially all nodes retained
    retained = set(node_by_id.keys())
    # Sort node ids: depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_ids = sorted(node_by_id.keys(), key=lambda nid: (-node_by_id[nid]['depth'], nid))
    removed_order = []
    for nid in sorted_ids:
        node = node_by_id[nid]
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        if nid == 'root':  # root id assumed "root"
            continue
        if node['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # Check no retained children
        children = parent_children.get(nid, [])
        if any(child in retained for child in children):
            continue
        # Remove node
        retained.remove(nid)
        removed_order.append(nid)
    # Retained ids sorted
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
